changes.text:
@hheskihoran round 2 has our answers on both points, and neither holds step 1.

**Registry: yes.** We will register our key, one signed request, no account, so the finalized receipt carries the transparency-log leaf. Inclusion that a third party can check is the point of logging it at all; a file only the two parties hold proves less. Your two limits stand as our reading too: one receipt between two parties who arranged it in public, with you controlling `agentA`, is evidence of the bytes and of the inclusion check. It is not reputation evidence for either side, and we will not cite it as any.
